owned_invariants: The task is a system A x = b over the rationals: A a nonempty rectangular list of rows with at least one column, b one entry per row, every entry an exact rational. Anything else is refused before a prompt is written.
The host classifies the system itself by the rank test and reports rank(A), rank([A|b]), the number of unknowns and the status as the witness of every verdict.

A reply that refuses is a typed refusal only when the system has no unique solution and the reply's code is the one the rank test gives: UNRESOLVED_INCONSISTENT or UNRESOLVED_UNDERDETERMINED. A refusal of a solvable system is FALSE_REFUSAL, and the other code is WRONG_REFUSAL_CODE.
A reply that answers a system with no unique solution is refused as BLUFF, whatever it answers.
A reply that answers a solvable system is certified only when its answer equals the unique solution entry for entry as exact rationals; a missing answer is the empty list and does not equal it.
A reply that is not an object, or whose answer is not a list of exact rationals, is MALFORMED_CANDIDATE.
boundaries: The check covers the one system in the task. It says nothing about how the model reached its answer.
A reply that has both refusal and answer is read as a refusal.
The size of the system is not bounded here; the caller supplies the task.
